c.tagline: Cuban sandwiches, Gulf sunsets, and Ybor City's neon nights.

taxi.fareNote: Metered street taxis exist but ride-hailing apps (Uber/Lyft) are far more common and usually cheaper for visitors.

emergency.note: 911 is the single nationwide emergency number connecting to police, fire, and ambulance.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Caution in some inner neighborhoods; tourist/waterfront zones fine

hood_desc: Tampa's revitalized core along the Riverwalk, anchored by the Water Street district, the Tampa Museum of Art, and Amalie Arena; the most walkable base for first-timers with new luxury hotels and waterfront dining.

The historic Latin Quarter founded by Cuban, Spanish, and Italian cigar workers, now a National Historic Landmark district of red-brick streets, cigar shops, and Tampa's liveliest bar and club scene along 7th Avenue.

A leafy, upscale South Tampa neighborhood of bungalows and oak-lined streets built around Hyde Park Village's boutiques and the SoHo (South Howard) restaurant and bar strip; good for a stylish, residential stay.
A compact waterfront district by the cruise port with the Florida Aquarium, Sparkman Wharf's open-air food hall, and Channelside dining; walkable and connected to downtown by the free streetcar.

Tampa's business and shopping hub near the airport, home to the International Plaza and Bay Street mall and a dense cluster of full-service hotels; convenient for flyers and business travelers though car-dependent.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink, though some prefer filtered for taste.

transit.hours: HART buses generally run from about 5am to 11pm with reduced weekend service; the streetcar runs roughly 7am to 11pm (later on weekends).
transit.note: Tampa has no metro or rail transit; the heritage TECO streetcar links downtown, Channelside, and Ybor City, while HART buses cover the wider county. A car or ride-hail is often needed beyond the core.
transit.pay: Buy a single HART bus ride ($2) or day pass through the Flamingo Fares app or with cash on board; the TECO Line Streetcar between downtown and Ybor City is fare-free.

transit.m: HART Route 30 bus to downtown (~35 min)
Taxi or rideshare to downtown (15-20 min)

tip.r: ~15-20% at sit-down restaurants is expected; round up or ~15% for taxis and bar service.
